jetour-x70-plus.name: Jetour X70 Plus
jetour-x70-plus.description: The Jetour X70 Plus delivers a premium SUV experience with a refined, spacious cabin, advanced infotainment, and a smooth ride — ideal for executive airport transfers and corporate commutes across Cairo and beyond.

mitsubishi-xpander-cross-25.name: Mitsubishi Xpander Cross
mitsubishi-xpander-cross-25.description: The Mitsubishi Xpander Cross combines bold SUV styling with flexible 7-seat MPV practicality. Its elevated ground clearance, spacious cabin, and abundant luggage room make it the top choice for family trips and group corporate travel.

chery-tiggo-8.name: Chery Tiggo 8
chery-tiggo-8.description: The Chery Tiggo 8 is a statement in modern luxury — a feature-loaded 7-seat crossover with panoramic roof, premium ambient lighting, and an impressively quiet cabin. Perfect for VIP transfers and high-profile arrivals.

toyota-hiace.name: Toyota Hiace
toyota-hiace.description: The Toyota Hiace is Egypt's leading choice for premium group travel. Offering a high-roof design, comfortable seating for up to 14 passengers, and dedicated luggage space, it is perfect for large families, corporate delegations, and VIP tours.
